extraction_scope: Bounded re-review of XML, PDF text, Figure 1 image labels, supplementary ZIP PDF text, and linked DBAASP rows recovered source-supported IC50 and combination viability records without fabricating unreported dose-response table values.
nonblocking_limitations: Full per-dose viability coordinates in Figure 1 are plotted image data, not a recoverable local table; only labeled IC50 values and abstract combination viability percentages were curated.
